# technitium_record_srv (Resource)

Manages a single `SRV` record in an authoritative zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "technitium_zone" "srv_home" {
  zone = "srv.example.com"
}

resource "technitium_record_srv" "sip" {
  zone     = technitium_zone.srv_home.zone
  domain   = "_sip._tcp.srv.example.com"
  priority = 10
  weight   = 60
  port     = 5060
  target   = "sip.srv.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The record's domain name, for example `www.example.com`. Use the zone name for a record at the zone apex.
- `port` (Number) The port the service listens on.
- `priority` (Number) The target's priority. Lower values are tried first.
- `target` (String) The domain name of the host that provides the service.
- `weight` (Number) The relative weight of targets with the same priority.
- `zone` (String) The authoritative zone that holds the record.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Comments stored with the record.
- `disable` (Boolean) Disable the record without deleting it. Defaults to `false`.
- `expiry_ttl` (Number) Deletes the record automatically this many seconds after it was last modified. Terraform then creates it again on the next apply. Defaults to `0`, which keeps the record.
- `ttl` (Number) The record TTL in seconds. Defaults to the default record TTL in the server settings.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# zone/domain/priority/weight/port/target
terraform import technitium_record_srv.sip srv.example.com/_sip._tcp.srv.example.com/10/60/5060/sip.srv.example.com
```
